findings.description: NEW issues introduced by this change-set only. Never repeat an already-listed open finding here; use still_open for those.

id.description: null for NEW findings. Set an existing open id ONLY if you are certain this is the same prior open issue (prefer still_open instead).

file.description: Path relative to the repo, prefixed with the '### Repo:' relative path when there are multiple repos.

line.description: Line number; 0 if file-wide or cross-file.

issue.description: Short, direct description of the problem.

severity.description: critical = breaks correctness/security; major = significant correctness or design problem; minor = quality, style, small improvement.

kind.description: intent_gap = diff does not implement the stated intent; bug = correctness/security defect in the diff itself; quality = maintainability, performance, or style issue.

resolved.description: Ids from the Open ledger that ARE genuinely fixed in the current code.

still_open.description: Ids from the Open ledger that are NOT yet fixed. Every open id must appear in exactly one of resolved or still_open.

reraised.description: Dismissed ids you are re-raising WITH concrete new evidence.

summary.description: Required substantive paragraph describing the review and overall change quality, even when there are no findings. Null is only permitted for an explicit refusal with a concrete refusal_reason; blank or placeholder text is not a review.

refused.description: True only when the bundle cannot be reviewed. A refusal carries no findings or ledger changes and does not count as a pass.

refusal_reason.description: Concrete explanation when refused is true; null for a completed review.
